# wheatdata — Source and Attribution

`wheatdata.csv` is distributed in this package under the terms of the GPL,
consistent with its original source in the **SpATS** R package
(Rodríguez-Álvarez et al.).

## Original dataset

Gilmour, A.R., Cullis, B.R., and Verbyla, A.P. (1997).
Accounting for natural and extraneous variation in the analysis of field
experiments. *Journal of Agricultural, Biological, and Environmental
Statistics*, **2**, 269–293.

## Contents

330 observations from a wheat yield trial in South Australia.
22 rows × 15 columns per field, 107 genotypes, 3 replicates.

| Column   | Description                              |
|----------|------------------------------------------|
| yield    | Grain yield (numeric)                    |
| geno     | Genotype identifier                      |
| rep      | Replicate block                          |
| row      | Row coordinate                           |
| col      | Column coordinate                        |
| rowcode  | Row blocking code                        |
| colcode  | Column blocking code                     |
